advisors.delta: All counts unchanged from the scoped Xstore setup checkpoint. Existing baseline findings remain documented.

contract.input: Native admin connection_id, limit (1..100, default 25), after_external_id; no caller financial payload or metrics action.
contract.source: Latest tenant/connection-provenance transaction ingestion event for each external ID; normalized JSON receipt ID must equal ingestion external ID.
contract.dates: Explicit ISO date interpreted as UTC or ISO timestamp with offset; missing/ambiguous dates fail.
contract.writes: POS/sales/line facts atomic per receipt; stale line facts replaced. Receipt identity includes connection ID.
contract.attribution: Confirmed destination-reviewed same-connection location queue plus entity map; employee queue plus matching provider/store POS map and active organization member.

limits: No real provider, signed-in browser or import was run. Resumable Xstore sync remains gated; its existing dependency list is a workflow gate rather than deployed-function inventory.
Only normalized top-level JSON transaction events are supported. Raw nested XML/POSLog and refund event types need a reviewed adapter.
Header/line totals, refunds, retail timezone/calendar, inferred service categories and historical receipt duplication require reconciliation.
Sales facts currently use UTC dates; metric refresh is explicitly false and dashboard activation remains pending.
Prepared apps are not hosted; final data/Storage deltas, hosted cutover and source retirement remain pending.
